correction: SELECT [A-Za-z]+ from [table_name] where [table_name]._id not in ( select [table_name]._id from [table_name] group by [table_name]._id having sum([cost_column]) > [number] )

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly checks for treatments with a cost less than a certain amount, by looking for dogs that have spent more than the specified amount on treatments.
